caveat: All metrics computed on 2980 structured citizen-science records (iNaturalist + GBIF curated datasets). Treat as directional, not statistically definitive. Spatial and temporal biases exist (citizen-science skew toward accessible roads, monsoon-season overrepresentation in some datasets).
notes: Model trained on structured citizen-science data from iNaturalist and GBIF. Predictive layer is secondary to the evidence layer. No risk scores are extrapolated into zero-coverage areas.

honesty_ladder.consequence: Structured record threshold met. Predictive model may be promoted once validated on held-out spatial splits.
data_sources: iNaturalist: structured field query for Roadkill=Yes observations in India
India Roadkill Monitoring Project (GBIF, 491 records, CC-BY 4.0)
Anamalai Hills / Valparai Plateau (GBIF, 2473 records, CC-BY 4.0)
honesty_ladder.bias_note: Datasets have spatial/temporal bias: citizen-science skew toward accessible roads, monsoon-season overrepresentation in some studies. See methodology page for details.
